title: The Armageddon Man
build: Martech's original PAL disk of 1987, a bit-level G64 of the protected original from the C64 Preservation Project, armageddon_man[martech_1987](cyan2)(pal).g64, SHA-256 8f2cf80d...; booted with the copy protection's verdict page assisted in the emulator (orientation.md)

credits.by: J Wilson, D Martin, B Notarianni and R France
credits.role: Spectrum program and game design, as the C64 instruction booklet credits them; it names nobody for the C64 version
graphics, as the C64 instruction booklet credits them
music, as the C64 instruction booklet credits it

tools.emulator: VICE 3.10, the vice-mcp release v3.14.0, v3.14.0-linux-x86_64-gui.zip
tools.host: Linux x86_64, Ubuntu 24.04, no display (cloud container)

accuracy.note: two strata: 60 of 1,083 comments written one by one (8 wrong), 20 of 446 written by a script from each record (5 wrong, one template)
live tests in VICE: a war watched to its end, the year's end and Armageddon
the page's widgets, each tested against the game's own routine in the kit's 6502: the satellite cover test showed in_cover's reach one pixel too wide

exclude: runtime: zero page, the stack and pages 2 and 3, the game's pointers and work bytes; clear_zero_page clears zero page at start-up, and at the hand-over pages 2 and 3 still hold the fast loader's C64 side ($02A6-$03F5), which the game never calls
the loader's, never named by the game: its transfer tables, its code at $0500 and, at $0700, a copy of the hand-over that runs from $03DE (unblank the screen, $01 = $04, jmp $4E96)
after the last text, loaded with the game and never read: alternate $00 and $FF bytes with a few bits flipped, the pattern of RAM at power-on, saved with the image
extra: the title picture's colours, loaded with the game and never shown
the title picture's bitmap, loaded with the game and never shown; windows save what they cover from $2000 up in play
the main screen's picture, loaded with the game: map, frame, icons and stripes

regions: the title picture's colours, never shown
a developer's loader left from the game's making
the title picture's bitmap, never shown
the music driver, four tunes, 17 sound effects and an alarm
the events', intercepts', Big Bird messages' and communiques' texts
the game's state, which RAMSAVE copies
the countries' event, intercept and Big Bird levels
the event, mail, letter and follow-up scripts
